import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Dataset with outliers
data = {
    'income': [30000, 35000, 40000, 42000, 45000, 48000, 50000, 500000],
    'age': [25, 28, 30, 32, 35, 38, 40, 45],
    'score': [60, 65, 70, 72, 75, 78, 80, 99]
}
df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Calculate median and IQR (Q3 - Q1) for each column
medians = df.median()
Q1 = df.quantile(0.25)
Q3 = df.quantile(0.75)
IQR = Q3 - Q1

# Implement robust scaling: (x - median) / IQR
df_robust = (df - medians) / IQR

# Compare with min-max scaling
df_minmax = (df - df.min()) / (df.max() - df.min())

# Print results showing how robust scaling handles outliers better
print("Original Data:")
print(df)
print("\nMin-Max Scaled (outlier distorts scale):")
print(df_minmax.round(3))
print("\nRobust Scaled (outlier resistant):")
print(df_robust.round(3))
